workflow_a_detection.name: Landslide Event Detection Feature Set (Experimental Point-Zone Disturbance Assessment)
workflow_a_detection.objective: Classify post-hoc occurrence of ground disturbance using pre/post satellite change
workflow_a_detection.spatial_uncertainty_caveat: NASA catalog coordinates carry +/- 5km uncertainty. Evaluates point-zone disturbance proxy, not validated scar-level detection.

workflow_b_susceptibility_core.name: Cloud-Independent Core Susceptibility Set
workflow_b_susceptibility_core.objective: Pre-event spatial landslide susceptibility modeling with all-weather completeness (>96%)
workflow_b_susceptibility_core.rainfall_conditioning: Conditioned on 30-day antecedent rainfall and API (alpha=0.90)

workflow_b_susceptibility_optical.name: Optical-Enhanced Susceptibility Set
workflow_b_susceptibility_optical.objective: Pre-event spatial susceptibility modeling including Sentinel-2 spectral indices
workflow_b_susceptibility_optical.missingness_note: Carries 31.5% missing data due to Himalayan monsoon clouds

workflow_b_susceptibility_reduced.name: Reduced Susceptibility Set (Terrain Bias Diagnostic)
workflow_b_susceptibility_reduced.objective: Pre-event spatial susceptibility modeling excluding slope and TRI to evaluate terrain confound
